Container.Name: Takt
Container.Overview: Takt backend for the Leipzig/MDV transit app. Downloads the open DELFI timetable (gtfs.de) weekly and OpenStreetMap monthly, cuts them to the MDV area, prepares the input for the Takt-MOTIS container, filters the DELFI GTFS-Realtime feed and serves a small JSON API for the Android app. S-Bahn/regional realtime and disruption messages come from INSA. Image is built locally (deploy.sh). Data: DELFI e.V. / gtfs.de (CC BY 4.0, realtime CC BY-SA 4.0), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
Container.Requires: Takt-MOTIS (journey planner and departures, uses the folder motis/ inside this container's data folder)

Config.Name: API-Port
Config.Description: Port the app connects to. Public access only through the NetBird reverse proxy (HTTPS), never by port forwarding.

Config.Name: Daten
Config.Description: Cache, prepared timetable, station list. Subfolder motis/ is mounted into Takt-MOTIS.

Config.Name: Eigene URL fuer MOTIS
Config.Description: Where Takt-MOTIS reaches this container (for the filtered realtime feed)

Config.Name: Gebiet (BBOX)
Config.Description: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat of the area to keep

Config.Name: Echtzeit aktiv (s)
Config.Description: Realtime poll interval while the app is in use (feed is ~6 MB per fetch)

Config.Name: Echtzeit idle (s)
Config.Description: Realtime poll interval when the app was not used for 15 min

Config.Name: INSA
Config.Description: Use INSA HAFAS for S-Bahn realtime, disruptions and as fallback (unofficial)

Config.Name: API-Token
Config.Description: Optional single token (min. 32 chars). Preferred: one token per person in tokens.txt in the data folder (./tokens.sh).

Config.Name: Token Pflicht
Config.Description: true: refuse to start without a valid token. Set when the API is reachable from the internet.
